name: code-review-happy

inputs.task: Add clamp(n, lo, hi) to src/math.ts: returns n limited to the inclusive range [lo, hi]; throws a RangeError when lo > hi. Export it from src/index.ts and cover it with tests, including the lo > hi case.

prompt_suffix: Everything for this run lives inside the fixture: its stub `gh` is first on PATH and it is its own origin. Committing, branching, pushing to that origin and merging through `gh` are expected here. For the second review, run `claude -p` from Bash with the diff. Never touch any real GitHub repository.

judge.question: All must hold: (1) src/math.ts exports clamp(n, lo, hi) that returns n limited to [lo, hi] and throws a RangeError when lo > hi; (2) src/index.ts re-exports clamp; (3) src/math.test.ts (or another test file shown) covers clamp including the lo > hi throw; (4) the git log shows the work landed on main through a merge of a feature branch (a 'Merge pull request' commit), not by committing straight to main.
